subject: Emotions
title: Core vs Moral Disgust
description: One-minute skill: Core vs Moral Disgust.

hook.text: Rotten meat and a corrupt politician both trigger the word 'disgusting.' Is it the same emotion?

buildup.text: Core disgust protects the body from pathogens. Moral disgust protects the group from bad actors.

discovery.text: Brain scans show overlap. The insula fires for both rotten food and moral betrayal.

twist.text: But moral disgust activates extra regions—the prefrontal cortex joins in, adding judgment to revulsion.

climax.text: Humans hijacked a food reflex and turned it into a moral compass. Biology became ethics.

punchline.text: The same brain region rejects bad food and bad people.

quiz.question: What brain region activates for both types of disgust?
